en: Black‑and‑white / sepia postcard view of a large three‑storey historicist school building with a central risalit, arched windows on the upper floor, and a small clock or roundel in the gable. A tree‑lined yard and gravel piles are in the foreground, with a few people—likely children and adults—standing near the entrance. At the top in red Gothic-style print is the German caption identifying the school in Ehrenfriedersdorf in the Erzgebirge region.
